subject: spanish

rounds.lie: “Ayer fui al cine” means “Tomorrow I will go to the cinema”.
rounds.why: “Ayer fui” is the past tense: “Yesterday I went”. “Tomorrow I will go” is “Mañana iré”.
rounds.truth: “Ayer fui al cine” means “Yesterday I went to the cinema”.
truths: “El año pasado fui a un concierto” means “Last year I went to a concert”.

rounds.lie: “El estrés me agobia” means “stress relaxes me”.
rounds.why: “Agobiar” means “to overwhelm/stress out”, so it means “stress overwhelms me”, the opposite of relaxing.
rounds.truth: “El estrés me agobia” means “stress overwhelms me”.
truths: “Llevar una vida sana” means “to lead a healthy life”.

rounds.why: Another false friend — “constipado” means “to have a cold”. “Constipated” is “estreñido”.
truths: “Llevo una vida sana” means “I lead a healthy life”.
“Evito la comida basura” means “I avoid junk food”.

rounds.why: “Soler” in the present means “to usually do”: “I usually read”. “I used to read” is “solía leer”.
truths: “Los fines de semana descanso” means “At weekends I rest”.
“Hago deporte tres veces a la semana” means “I do sport three times a week”.
“Me llevo bien con mis padres” means “I get on well with my parents”.
“Soy hijo único” means “I am an only child”.

rounds.lie: “Tengo que repasar” means “I want to rest”.
rounds.why: “Repasar” = to revise and “tengo que” = I have to. “I want to rest” would be “quiero descansar”.
rounds.truth: “Tengo que repasar” means “I have to revise”.
truths: “Quiero ser enfermero” means “I want to be a nurse”.
“Hago mis deberes” means “I do my homework”.

rounds.lie: “No se permite usar el móvil en clase” means “you may use your phone in class”.
rounds.why: “No se permite” means “it is not allowed”, so phones are forbidden, not permitted.
rounds.truth: “No se permite usar el móvil en clase” means “you may not use your phone in class”.
